reflections: Bo is actively helping with the repair drive and is willing to contribute supplies.
Cleo appears to be coordinating the remaining needs for the group.
Nell is less informed and asking for updates, suggesting she is peripheral to the coordination so far.
Bo is reliably helpful and focused on concrete contributions, especially supplies and follow-through.
The group is coordinating around a repair drive, but key logistics like the drop-off location are still unresolved.
Cleo and Dane are both trying to distribute tasks, while Opal is tracking logistics and asking for missing details.
Bo is trying to help in practical ways but lacks key details and keeps asking for clarification.
The group needs one person to confirm logistics, especially the drop-off location and repair drive setup.
Dane, Rey, and Hana are helping by narrowing tasks and matching people or supplies to the right repair jobs.
Bo is taking on a practical coordination role and is responsive about bringing supplies and checking logistics.
Hana is organizing the repair drive by matching available supplies to repair needs, while Opal is tracking the location detail.
The group is cooperative and task-focused, with Gus resolving the location and offering tools, which helps move the effort forward.
Bo is the most active coordinator, checking details, correcting updates, and offering to spread information or help.
The group is adapting to a schedule/location change to Sunday at the community center, and everyone is confirming the new plan.
Helpers are flexible and practical, often offering tools, extra hands, or word-of-mouth support to keep the repair drive moving.
